_meta.rule: This file may name NOTHING specific to a place. If a value here would differ between two households, it does not belong here — it belongs in what the person tells us at onboarding.

theme._note: NO `main` ON PURPOSE [2026-09-08]. An estate that has not chosen a colour declares none, and build-viewer answers from engine/palette.json `unchosen`. Four instances repeating one hex is the drift this repo pays for repeatedly — and it had already happened: all five declared Fernwood's #2f5d3a. The person's own colour is chosen at onboarding and stored on their account; this path is only the unconfigured build.

display._rule: what an UNCONFIGURED device is served; a device with a stored choice keeps it.
